title: Model 12% at DraftKings' own prices
note: Blend Lean and Model 12% exactly as live, entered at DraftKings' own price 48 hours before kickoff from the bought ten-book history, CLV against Pinnacle's margin-free close in the same snapshot. Beside it, the same rules on the same matches at football-data's Pinnacle early price. Method fixed in docs/leagues.md before the run.

rule.price: DraftKings' quoted 1X2 48 hours before kickoff (bought history), break-even = 1/decimal
rule.chance: the model's own walk-forward chance (no blend), as the live test
rule.pick: biggest edge of at least 12% among home, draw and away (trades.best_pick)
rule.clv: entry odds x Pinnacle's margin-free (Shin) close in the same snapshot - 1
rule.cup: DraftKings' close (bought, The Odds API), break-even = 1/decimal; entry odds x Pinnacle's margin-free (Shin) close - 1

bands.edge_from: model_p x odds - 1 (the model's own edge)
bands.note: Every bet, split by its decimal odds (lo < odds <= hi), by the edge the strategy claimed when it bet, and by its CLV; the edge and CLV bands are cut at the pooled domestic leagues' quintiles, the same cuts in every league. ROI and CLV are per $1 with 95% ranges from resampling matches. If the model had skill, CLV would rise with the claimed edge.

calibration.note: Every outcome (home, draw, away) of every scored match, not only the bets: the model's raw walk-forward chance, the blend and the price (margin-free), each against what happened; `bets` is the strategy's own picks (predicted vs 1/odds vs won). Each bin holds the rows whose predicted chance falls in it: predicted is their average chance, implied the price's, realized how often they won (95% range). On a well-calibrated model realized sits on predicted. The slope is from logit(won) = a + b x logit(predicted): below 1 the chances are too spread out (over-confident).

clv_dk.note: CLV against DraftKings' own close (descriptive); the judged CLV is against Pinnacle's close in the same snapshot

flat.note: Tracked alternative only: the same trades with a different stake, no new bets; flat $10 stays the record. Paper bankroll $1,000 at the first trade; quarter Kelly (0.25 x f*, f* = (p x odds - 1) / (odds - 1)), at most 5% of the bankroll a bet, nothing when f* <= 0. Each stake uses only the bankroll from bets settled before it opened; pushes and voids return the stake. Kelly assumes p is right: every strategy's CLV is below 0, so the edge it sizes on is not proven.

kelly.p_note: p = the blend's chance (p_bet for Lean; the blend's chance for Model 12%'s side).

kelly_raw.p_note: p = the raw model's chance: Kelly on the raw model (over-confident). The model rates the side it likes higher than it wins, so this over-bets.

all.note: Early-price leagues only; the Champions League (priced at the close) is reported on its own.

clv_dk.note: CLV against DraftKings' own close (descriptive); the judged CLV is against Pinnacle's close in the same snapshot

coverage_note: Coverage per league and season: early = DraftKings priced the match 48 hours before kickoff (only those are bet); close = Pinnacle's close was in the same snapshot (the judged CLV needs it). DraftKings history starts in 2020/21 (2021/22 for Ligue 1 and League Two); a season counts only where the Pinnacle backtests score it too.

verdict.rule: pooled CLV vs Pinnacle's close in the same snapshot: 95% range above 0
